ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe is characterized by a large, contiguous high-intensity white region bounded by black perimeter pixels. The right lobe contains a complex, non-contiguous network of black linear patterns and mottling. A concentrated black pixel cluster is situated at the center-bottom junction near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 1/6th the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the continuous trailing boundary. Right lobe exhibits significantly deeper and more jagged pixel-amplitude variations compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer margins of both lobes, sweeping upward towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular pixel rings (approx. 10-15 pixels in diameter) observed on the mid-right lobe. High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized on the black background of both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive series of parallel and intersecting low-intensity linear tracks localized on the right lobe, measuring between 40 and 180 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular tissue loss and erosion at both distal tips, particularly the right tip, exhibiting high-intensity calcareous-like textured masses.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive circular 'O-shaped' low-intensity mark located on the inner quadrant of the right lobe.
